title: Whodunnit: The Late Night Heist
story: On a moonlit night, the city's finest art gallery was robbed of a priceless painting - "The Enigmatic Masterpiece". The victim, Gallery Owner Sarah Winslow, woke up to a broken door lock and a mysterious note left on the vandalized counter: 'You can't catch a true artist.'
crimeScene: The scene was chaotic, with shattered glass, and a trail of golden paint leading to the exit. A single set of footprints were found in the foyer - size 8 males.
forensicClue: A distinctive half-erased signature found on a nearby easel, possibly left by the culprit.
question: Who committed the crime and why?
